The base transfer capital payment is the transfer adjustment factor * $194.26. The transfer capital threshold is the transfer adjustment factor * $194.26. If the capital cost exceeds the transfer capital threshold  the stay qualifies for a transfer capital outlier of 80% of the excess amount.
